$comment: Continental Rift slice placeholder (#203) - NOT content, never shipped. The environmental fight (#201) on the cracking ice shelf, adapted from the Drowned Ferry sandbox: a four-round collapse clock, a line of rift frost, a crack in the glacier wall open until round 4, and a yeti reader to free. Freeing the reader sets the journey flag reader_freed, which the glacier node's completion rule turns into the yeti-readers world fact. The Rift Spark (and Marsh Mettle, if the party took the side trip) is spent here.
title: The Cracking Shelf

goal.text: Keep your feet on the cracking ice shelf.

steps.label: Win the fight or slip away

scene_shelf.narration: You step out onto an ice shelf at the top of the world. A yeti reader is stuck in a crack beside the glacier wall, and two frost wisps drift up out of the snow.

fight_shelf.narration: The shelf groans. Every round, the crack in the wall grows narrower.

exits.label: The crack in the glacier wall

onVictory.narration: The last frost wisp crumbles into snow.

onDefeat.narration: The shelf tips, and you slide.

onEscape.narration: You squeeze through the crack as it grinds shut.

variants.text: The yeti reader squeezes through after you, blinking.
Behind you, the reader is still stuck in the ice.

onTimeout.narration: The whole shelf breaks away with a roar.

scene_held.narration: The shelf is quiet. Far below, you hear meltwater begin to run.

variants.text: The reader bows and says the readers will remember you.

scene_through.narration: Inside the glacier wall it is blue and still. Far below, you hear meltwater begin to run.

scene_slid.narration: You wake at the bottom of the shelf, cold and sore. The wisps are gone.

scene_collapse.narration: The shelf throws you into a snowdrift and slides away down the mountain.
